figurative_meaning_en: Pot-bellied or having a swollen midsection
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এত খেয়ে পেটমোটা হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become pot-bellied from overeating.
The wealthy man in the village looks pot-bellied.
note: Often implies prosperity or overindulgence in Bengali culture
